integrity: The ambient variational free-lattice norm is attributed to the cited sources; derived orientation-moment, equality and windmill results are proved in RESULT.md; no independent validation or priority guarantee is represented.
scientific_limitations: Real finite graphs; all-p exact family only for friendship graphs, cycles, and complete graphs. No polynomial-time evaluation claim for general graphs; finite checker does not establish infinite cases; possible unindexed equivalent results remain.
title: Orientation moments and exact friendship-graph variation norms in free convex Banach lattices
